title: Waiting list that retries matching every 6 hours
text:
Right now a student who can't be matched just sees "no group yet" and has to come back and try again.

**Proposal**

* Unmatched students are put on a waiting list automatically
* A background job re-runs matching for everyone on the list every 6 hours
* When a group forms, send a push notification and an in-app banner
* After 7 days without a match, ask the student if they want to widen their free-time slots

Daniel is building the job in `pairly-api`. Sam needs the notification payload agreed before he can wire up the banner.

Depends on the Android 15 notification fix, otherwise a lot of testers will never see the "you have a group" push.
